_comment: Owner-runnable prompt evaluation. Each case is one model call; expectations are checked by backend/internal/provider/live_eval_test.go under LIVE_LLM=1, and TestEvalFixturesParse refuses a misspelt key in CI. Strings in contains/excludes are case-insensitive; `note`, `title_names` and `sources` name a fixture title; `script`/`title_script` name a Unicode script. Add a case by appending an object; no Go needed.
